_comment: Shared simp/trad conversion exceptions. Read by build_dict.py (for the dict 's' field) and build_convert.py (for the runtime converter) so both stay consistent. 'invariant': chars never converted in EITHER direction (e.g. Wu-specific 睏, which OpenCC would wrongly merge with 困). 's2t'/'t2s': explicit remaps that win over OpenCC's tables.
